messages.author: 4f6f5f995ee31178
messages.subject: ID as symbols?
parts:
Hi!

given, i.e.
> x=runif(100,1,10)
> y = x^2-10 + rnorm(100)
> z=1:100
> g = round(z/4)

What would be the ggplot2 equivalent of
plot(x,y,type="n")
text(x,y,labels=z,cex=0.7,col=g)

I've not been able to find an specific geom(). I've tried:
> qplot(x,y,colour=g,shape=z)

but this is not what I want and generates many Warning messages.

Thanks

Agus

messages.subject: RE: ID as symbols?
parts:
First (and slightly unrelated) ggplot2 expects data as a dataframe, so you
might get furthur with

> mydataframe<-data.frame(x=x, y=y, z=z, g=g)
> qplot(mydataframe, x, y, colour=g, shape=z)

Regards,

Paul.
